_comment: Machine-readable index of Hermes plugins maintained by rarf. install.sh reads this. Each plugin keeps its OWN repo (per-plugin history/PRs) — the hub only clones/updates them into HERMES_HOME/plugins/<path>. Do NOT use git submodules here; that would fold plugin history into the hub and break the standalone-repo guarantee.

plugins.description: Per-provider LLM quota / rate-limit footer block + /quota slash & CLI command.
